## Design

### 2026-10-05 — ![PNG image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/WKHlWTArmY0mZYT5WZnx8k27wposj8rz/b98b0cd94d7f0b183efc1fd3ffb818ec116edd2dc43c06469d7e67193712d07c.png)

**2.33h**

![PNG image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/WKHlWTArmY0mZYT5WZnx8k27wposj8rz/b98b0cd94d7f0b183efc1fd3ffb818ec116edd2dc43c06469d7e67193712d07c.png)

I finished the PCB and the Schematic! Basically, this pad has 24 LED, and I use multiplexing to save GPIO pins. It also has a seven segment display and a few buttons so it can be interactive!

The microcontroller is a Raspberry Pi Pico 1.

### 2026-10-06 — ![Screenshot 2026-10-06 at 8.31.12 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/WKHlWTArmY0mZYT5WZnx8k27wposj8rz/289f8daa0ad5850755dfff0e2e3b12ea6d21d6dfb6c68149330e585fa36e397

**1.33h**

![Screenshot 2026-10-06 at 8.31.12 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/WKHlWTArmY0mZYT5WZnx8k27wposj8rz/289f8daa0ad5850755dfff0e2e3b12ea6d21d6dfb6c68149330e585fa36e397a.png)

**I finished the updated new PCB!**

I changed the amount of lights from 24 LED (4 by 6 matrix) to 30 LED (5 by 6 matrix) with 3 different colors, RED, BLUE, and YELLOW, 10 LED each. This is because it's going to be easier and more efficient especially when you display numbers. The RED can stand for the hundreds digit, BLUE ten, and YELLOW first.

What really was hard though was routing and where to put all parts. Eventually, I put the microcontroller in the middle and all the LED connect to it. (don't worry if the microcontroller is a bit too low for the USB to reach, I will make sure that the case won't interfere with it)
